name: new_bench_summaries
description: A collection of short, human-written summaries describing newly created or compiled math benchmark tasks used in the RAG4Math project. Intended to provide concise metadata and task overviews to support retrieval-augmented generation and dataset curation workflows. Entries include brief task descriptions and annotations to help align retrieval and instruction prompts.
reputation: A niche dataset associated with the RAG4Math project; primarily of interest to researchers working on math-focused retrieval and summarization.
